title: Rebar Lap Splice Length in High Moment Plastic Hinge Zone

input.extracted_text:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
RFI Number: RFI-2026-004
Subject: Clarification on Column Rebar Lap Splice Length in Seismic Critical Region
Contract Reference: CON-2026-CS-001
Raised Date: 2026-03-15
Due Date: 2026-03-22
Status: answered

QUESTION:
Drawing S-104 shows lap splices of 32mm vertical rebar located at slab level in Column C-12. Per ACI 318 Section 18.7.4.3, lap splices in special moment frames are prohibited within the plastic hinge region (within 600mm or d of the joint face). Please confirm if mechanical type-2 couplers must be used instead.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-03-18
Confirmed: Replace all lap splices in Columns C-08 through C-16 at Levels 1-4 with Type 2 seismic mechanical couplers.
